title: LCP Core Definitions
description: Shared definitions for the LCP canonical core. Referenced by message-type and vertical schemas via $ref.

consumer.title: Consumer
consumer.description: The person the lead is about.

full_name.description: Unstructured name — use when Western given/family splitting does not apply.

secondary_phone.description: Secondary phone (work, spouse, alternate). E.164. Optional.

preferred_contact_method.description: Consumer's preferred contact method. Affects contact strategy and compliance.

email_hash.description: HMAC-SHA256(shared_secret, normalized_email). For dedup in ping. Same per-pair model as phone_hash.

consent_evidence_entry.title: Consent Evidence Entry
consent_evidence_entry.description: A single piece of consent or compliance evidence.

type.description: Consent framework or evidence type (e.g. tcpa_consent, gdpr_opt_in).

provider.description: Vendor or system (e.g. jornaya, trustedform, internal).

token_or_url.description: Verification token, certificate URL, or reference.

consent_purposes.description: What was consented to (e.g. calls, sms, email, share_with_partners).

otp.description: OTP verification details. Optional — if present, otp_verified should be true. The actual OTP code MUST NOT be included — it is ephemeral and poses a replay risk if leaked.

verified_value_hash.description: Hash of the value that was verified (phone or email). Do not include the raw value.

attempts.description: Number of OTP attempts before success. High counts may indicate fraud.

consent_expires_at.description: When the consent validity expires. Optional — if absent, consent does not expire. Buyers should not contact after this timestamp.

scrubs.description: Results of compliance scrubbing checks performed against the consumer's phone/email. Each entry is one scrub check.

type.description: Scrub type. Known values: dnc_national, dnc_state, dnc_internal, litigator, blacklist, fraud_check, carrier_lookup, number_portability. Open enumeration.
type.$comment: Open enum — new scrub types are additive.

provider.description: Service that performed the scrub (e.g. ftc_dnc, au_dncregister, litigator_list, tcpa_scrub, first_orion, hiya, internal). Open enumeration.

result.description: clean = passed the check; flagged = on a list but not blocked (buyer decides); blocked = on a list and should not be contacted; not_checked = scrub was not run.

details.description: Optional human-readable detail (e.g. 'matched litigator list: 3 prior TCPA filings'). Do not include PII.

source_type.description: OPEN ENUMERATION — known values: publisher, direct, agent, api, referral, organic, marketplace, outbound, scraped. Unknown values must be stored and passed through.
source_type.$comment: Was a closed enum. Opened per SPEC.md section 6 — new source types are additive.

acquisition_method.description: How the lead was acquired. Known values: paid_ad, organic_search, marketplace, gmb (Google Business Profile), directory, cold_outbound, warm_transfer, scraped, unknown. Open enumeration.

is_incentivized.description: True if the consumer was offered an incentive (free consultation, gift card, discount) to submit the lead. Buyers who don't want incentivized leads filter on this.

incentive_type.description: What incentive was offered (e.g. free_consultation, gift_card, discount_coupon, free_quote, cash_offer). Open enumeration.

platform_source.description: Ad/marketing platform the lead originated from (e.g. google_ads, facebook, tiktok, bing_ads, organic, direct). Open enumeration.

acting_for.description: Party the agent acts on behalf of.

attestation.description: Signed JWT proving agent identity and authority.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Vertical-specific fields. Shape defined by per-vertical JSON Schema in verticals/. Every field MUST be tagged ping_safe: true/false.

status.title: Lead Status
status.description: OPEN ENUMERATION — known values: NEW, PINGED, POSTED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, DUPLICATE, DISPUTED, REFUNDED, EXPIRED, CONVERTED, ARCHIVED. Unknown values MUST be stored and passed through, not rejected.
status.$comment: No enum constraint — this is an open enumeration per SPEC.md §6.

channel.title: Lead Channel
channel.description: OPEN ENUMERATION — known values: form, chat, click, api, agent, referral. Unknown values MUST be stored and passed through, not rejected.
channel.$comment: No enum constraint — this is an open enumeration per SPEC.md §6.

field.description: Field path that caused the error (e.g. consumer.phone).

errors_array.title: Errors Array
errors_array.description: Standard error response shape used in both HTTP error bodies and ack.errors[].

max_buyers.description: For shared leads, maximum buyers who may receive the lead.

expiry.title: Lead Expiry
expiry.description: Either expires_at or ttl_seconds. If the lead reaches expiry without acceptance, it transitions to EXPIRED.

security.title: Security Block
security.description: Transport-neutral HMAC signature. Mirrors X-LCP-Signature / X-LCP-Timestamp headers for non-HTTP transports.
